title: Air Station Kodiak hoists National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration personnel to maintain NOAA navigational aids
description: An Air Station Kodiak MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew hoists National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration contractors from a Pilot Rock cliffside in support of efforts to maintain remote NOAA navigational aids in Ressurection Bay, Alaska, June 1, 2018. Over the course of a week, Air Station Kodiak aircrews assisted NOAA contractors with servicing aids on Flat Rock, Pilot Rock, East Amatuli Island, and Augustine Island. U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Kodiak.
